# ffxf_load_balancer_pool (Resource)

Creates a load-balancer backend pool and manages its complete set of VM targets.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `load_balancer_id` (Number)
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `algorithm` (String) roundrobin or leastconn.
- `health_interval` (Number) Health-check interval, 2 to 60 seconds.
- `health_path` (String)
- `health_type` (String) tcp or http health checks.
- `protocol` (String) http or tcp.
- `send_proxy` (Boolean) Send PROXY protocol v2 to targets (TCP pools only).
- `targets` (Attributes List) Complete target set. Updating this list replaces all targets in the pool; each VM must belong to the load balancer's VPC. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--targets))

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--targets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `targets`

Required:

- `port` (Number)
- `vm` (Number)

Optional:

- `drain` (Boolean)
- `weight` (Number)

Read-Only:

- `address` (String)
- `health` (String)
- `hostname` (String)
- `id` (Number)
- `response_ms` (Number)
- `sessions` (Number)
